title: Supported quasi-coherent property is stable under integer shifts
statement: theorem supported_qcoh_stableShift (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] (T : Set X) : (supportedProperty X T).IsStableUnderShift ℤ

source.place: Tag 0A9A, definition of supported subcategory preceding lemma

proof.text: For arbitrary integers a and n, use homologyFunctor.shiftIso to identify H^n(K[a]) with H^(a+n)(K). Transfer quasi-coherence by isQuasicoherent.prop_of_iso. Map the isomorphism through the underlying additive presheaf functor and the stalk functor; injectivity of its underlying map transfers the given subsingleton stalk. This is a complete Lean proof with no new dependencies or holes.
